posts.text:
ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers build for the physical world.

We’re sharing our progress across mechanical design, electrical engineering, and simulation—from helping our hardware teams iterate faster to testing new workflows with industry collaborators.

posts.author: OpenAI
posts.name: OpenAI
posts.text:
Two OpenAI team members worked with GPT-6 Astra to design a prototype device for talking to Codex in under a week, as a side project.

Astra designed the enclosure, circuit board, interface, and software. Getting it manufactured still required several rounds of review and iteration.

posts.author: OpenAI
posts.name: OpenAI
posts.text:
We’re also working with engineers at Chip Ganassi Racing to turn 3D scans into editable CAD models and manufacturing drawings, and with Mazda to explore new vehicle designs through simulation.

Engineers review the outputs and help identify where the models need to improve.

posts.author: OpenAI
posts.name: OpenAI
posts.text: These are early steps, and we’re looking for engineers, engineering firms, and software partners to help shape what comes next.
